title: Representative signed shift equation for reindexing
statement:
theorem derived_shift_model {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} X.ProEt] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} Y.ProEt] (s : Option ℕ)
    (SX : Closed l E X s) (SY : Closed l E Y s)
    (TX : Models l E X s SX) (TY : Models l E Y s SY)
    (c : Comparison l E g s SX SY TX TY) :
    ∀ (P I : K l E Y s) (hI : I.IsKInjective) (a b : ℤ),
      derivedShiftEquation l E g s SX SY TX TY c
        ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj P)
        ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj I) a b

proof.text: Factor the two-input Hom map into the source comparison and the target comparison. Naturality of the normalized sourceShift in the target transports the target shift comparison past the inverse source shift. Apply derived_source_shift_square at M and N[b].

Apply derived_target_shift_square at M,N and map this equation through the output shift by -a. The fully proved private paste_shift_squares lemma combines these equations: functoriality gives the shifted target equation, naturality of F.commShiftIso(-a) moves the target shift past F, naturality of shiftFunctorAdd moves the shifted comparison to degree b-a, and F.commShiftIso_add fixes the combined commutation isomorphism. Expanding signedShift identifies precisely the required two composites. Specialize to M=Q(P), N=Q(I).
